A '''warehouse''' in [[Arginall City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] was the site of a meeting between an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] contact team led by [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Merak (Human)|Merak]], and [[Ketrian Altronel]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The warehouse was [[First mission to Hargeeva|raided]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] and all present were either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or captured.
